verdict.rationale: Blink's docs describe a Keys section for creating SSH key pairs and a Hosts section for saving named hosts, plus ssh-agent support. Together these suggest keys can be created once and used across saved hosts, but the evidence never says so explicitly, and secure storage is unconfirmed: a community user asks whether keys sit in the secure enclave and notes there is no security documentation. missing for 10: explicit documentation that one stored key or credential can be assigned to multiple hosts, evidence of a secure vault or Keychain/secure-enclave storage, support for credentials other than SSH keys, and hands-on corroboration.
